zh-CN:
更新内容
• 曲间过渡新增普通、无缝、固定交叉淡化和智能四种模式，手动「下一首」同样生效；交叉淡化时长可用滑块在 300–3000 毫秒之间调整
• 播放页支持 HDR 着色器背景、逐字歌词和标题，可调参考白点与峰值，随窗口所在显示器切换 SDR/HDR；新增频谱与辉光
• 恢复播放页上滑入场：上下滑与转场期间背景、歌词和标题继续更新，修复重进闪烁和转场掉帧；歌名、专辑与艺人默认悬停滚动，并降低封面内存占用
• 当前播放队列支持拖拽排序，修复队列条目的单击选中与双击切歌
• 手动切歌时播放条、封面、歌词和队列高亮立即切换，修复交叉淡化交接、暂停进度、网络歌曲队列推进，以及切歌时的封面闪烁和背景双影
• 曲库页签保留滚动位置与缩放并恢复入场动画；默认封面跟随明暗主题，缺少封面时切歌沿用封面动画
• 内置音频转换按曲库改动增量刷新列表；修复监听中断、目录改名和缺失收藏的增量更新
• Last.fm 官方要求自 12 月 1 日起持有 API Key 需订阅 Last.fm Pro，公告地址：https://support.last.fm/t/api-keys-will-require-pro-from-1st-december/121030
en:
Release Notes
• Playback transitions add normal, gapless, fixed crossfade and smart modes, also used by manual next, with crossfade adjustable from 300 to 3000 ms
• The playing page adds an HDR shader background, per-character lyrics and titles with adjustable white point and peak, following the display SDR/HDR state, plus spectrum glow
• The playing page slides in again on open and keeps updating background, lyrics and titles while sliding and transitioning, fixing re-entry flicker and transition frame drops; titles scroll on hover by default and cover memory use is lower
• The queue supports drag reordering, and single-click selection and double-click playback are fixed
• Manual track changes update bar, cover, lyrics and highlight at once, fixing crossfade handoff, paused position, network queue advance, cover flicker and background ghosting
• Library tabs keep scroll and zoom with entrance animations; the default cover follows the theme, and tracks without a cover keep the cover animation
• Audio conversion refreshes the list incrementally; fixed incremental updates after watcher interruptions, folder renames and missing favorites
• Last.fm requires a Pro subscription to hold an API key from 1 December, official notice: https://support.last.fm/t/api-keys-will-require-pro-from-1st-december/121030
